etr_slice.taxes: individual income tax after refundable credits, payroll tax including the employer's share, the estate tax, the tax on gains deemed realized at death, the annual wealth tax, and the corporate income tax spread over households

provenance.corp_note: The corporate rate is scored inside the model against the CBO corporate receipts baseline (years/corporate/scorer.py), and the dial runs piecewise-linear through the solo anchors like every other rate dial. The effective-rate chart shows the corporate income tax spread over households top-down (above-normal return, normal return and labor, with the foreign-owned share dropped), and the estate tax and the tax on gains deemed realized at death in separate slots.
